interface.route: mori simulate on the holdout draft call; export flags add a top-level `export_plans`; the application run (summary, exit 0) is unchanged even when an export is Unsupported
interface.step: --export-plan E prepares the bounded step at 1-based K-A reference record position E of --reference-slices 1 (E=0 refused); export_plans.step echoes {position, rule_start_line, source_control, profile_id:'sherlock-k-a/1'} of that record
interface.requests: --export-request CAP (repeatable) with CAP in constraint-json, structured-witness, native-witness-closure, lookup, interaction, custom-gate; artifacts are written under --export-dir and nothing else is written there
interface.operation_manifest: {manifest_id, reference_definition_id, profile_id, layout_version, operations:[{operation_id, op (interfaces.md names: FieldAdd, FieldMul, AssertZero, LimbExtract, CheckedU128Add/Sub/Mul, Select, ArenaRead, FrameRestore, helper classes), ordering:int distinct, inputs:[{name,type}], outputs:[{name,type}], source_locators:[..] non-empty, component_membership: source|component|source+component, witness_dependencies:[operation_id], witness_program_kind, constraint_component_locator (nullable), supported_status:{kind: Specified|Implemented|Unsupported, reason}}], omissions:[..]}
interface.constraint_plan: {plan_id, operation_manifest_id, layout_version, field_id, ordered_public_inputs, ordered_private_inputs, ordered_outputs, components:[{component_id, operation_id, source_locator, parameters}], required_capabilities, omissions:[{operation_id, reason}]}; every operation is a component or an omission
interface.witness_plan: {plan_id, operation_manifest_id, layout_version, input_bindings, nodes:[{node_id, operation_id, typed_inputs:[{name,type}], typed_outputs, dependencies:[node_id], last_use}], stable_topological_order:[node_id], output_bindings, slot_counts, program_kind}; dependencies precede in the order; every non-Unsupported operation has a node
interface.ids: manifest_id / plan_id = sha256 hex of canonical JSON of the object without its id; the three are distinct; both plans carry the manifest id
interface.backend_capabilities: {backend_id, source_membership, field_id, formats:[{format, midnight_zkir_exporter:false, supplies_witness_computation:bool (false for constraint-json)}], constraint_operations, witness_operations, lookup, interaction, custom_gates, structured_witness_ir, native_closures, field_layouts (each {supported:bool, ...})}
interface.exports: one entry per request: {request, disposition: emitted|unsupported, artifact:{path relative to export dir, sha256, bytes} | null, unsupported:{feature, reason, operation_id|source_locator} | null}; emitted iff the capability is supported; constraint-json artifact carries plan_id = constraint_plan.plan_id and no witness keys; structured-witness artifact carries plan_id = witness_plan.plan_id and the plan's nodes
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25) from the spec, interfaces.md and demonstrators.md; implementer proposals reviewed. The holdout reads the flags below; a spelling change is a CONTRACT CHANGE posted to sherlock-eval. A model_package.py report not bound to the selected reference record is a gap report.
